dessin: Three small software application windows stacked vertically one above the other with equal small gaps, all the same size and aligned, each a flat pale rectangle #FBFCF8 with a 2 px ink outline and a thin title bar along its top edge; each title bar contains only two tiny square buttons at its right end, no text. Each window shows a different simple work area drawn in thin ink lines: the top window, three small boxes linked by lines like a diagram; the middle window, a small table grid; the bottom window, a simple line drawing (a closed outline shape crossed by one line). Nothing outside the three windows.
